relations.text: Cadenceが2023年9月6日に、RambusからSerDesとメモリ・インターフェースPHYのIP事業を取得した
relations.text_en: On September 6, 2023, Cadence acquired the SerDes and memory interface PHY IP business from Rambus Inc.

source.label: Cadence Design Systems 10-K
source.quote: On September 6, 2023, Cadence acquired the serializer/deserializer (“SerDes”) and memory interface physical layer (“Memory”) IP business from Rambus Inc.

relations.text: Cadenceが2025年8月26日に、Arm LimitedからArtisan foundation IP事業を取得した
relations.text_en: On August 26, 2025, Cadence acquired the Artisan foundation IP business from Arm Limited

source.label: Cadence Design Systems 10-K
source.quote: On August 26, 2025, Cadence acquired the Artisan foundation IP business from Arm Limited.

relations.text: 2023年9月14日、CEVAとIntrinsixがCadenceとの株式譲渡契約を結んだ
relations.text_en: On September 14, 2023, Ceva and Intrinsix entered into a Share Purchase Agreement with Cadence

source.label: CEVA 10-K
source.quote: On September 14, 2023, the Company and Intrinsix, then its wholly owned subsidiary, entered into a Share Purchase Agreement (the “Agreement”) with Cadence Design Systems, Inc.

relations.text: ケイデンスと競合する

source.quote: U.S.-based competitors include Keysight Technologies, Inc., Schrödinger, Inc., and CEVA, Inc., while international competitors include Altium Limited (acquired by Renesas Electronics Corporation) and Zuken, Inc.

relations.text: GTCで、Grace Blackwellアーキテクチャに関するNVIDIAとの提携拡大と、エージェント型AIの協業を発表した
relations.text_en: At GTC, Cadence announced an expanded partnership with NVIDIA on its Grace Blackwell architecture and a collaboration on full-stack agentic AI solutions

source.label: Cadence Design Systems 8-K Ex.99 の発表
source.label_en: Cadence Design Systems 8-K Ex.99 press release
source.quote: • At the GPU Technology Conference (GTC), Cadence announced an expanded partnership with NVIDIA on its latest Grace Blackwell architecture and a collaboration on developing full-stack agentic AI solutions using the new Llama Nemotron Reasoning Model.

relations.text: ケイデンスのIP売上は伸び、Intelとの重要な契約が成長を際立たせた
relations.text_en: Cadence's IP revenue grew more than 40% year over year, highlighted by a significant agreement with Intel.

source.label: Cadence Design Systems 8-K Ex.99 の発表
source.label_en: Cadence Design Systems 8-K Ex.99 press release
source.quote: • IP revenue grew more than 40% year-over-year, driven by strong demand for Cadence’s Star IP portfolio, highlighted by a significant agreement with Intel and additional wins with leading semiconductor companies

relations.text: UMCは、28HPC+プロセスのアナログ・ミックスドシグナル・フローの認証でCadenceと協業する

source.label: United Microelectronics 20-F
source.quote: We and Cadence Design Systems collaborate on certification of analog/mixed-signal flow for 28HPC+ process.
